question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Urged** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Urged **means to strongly recommend or advise someone to do something. (किसी को कुछ करने के लिए दृढ़तापूर्वक अनुशंसा या सलाह देना) • **Example**: He urged his colleagues to consider the proposal seriously. • The sentence implies that someone was convinced or persuaded to do something, which fits the meaning of "urged". • The past tense form of "urge" is "urged", which is the correct grammatical form for the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Benefitted **means to receive an advantage or profit from something. (किसी चीज़ से लाभ या मुनाफ़ा प्राप्त करना) • **Invited **means to ask someone to come or go somewhere. (किसी को कहीं आने या जाने के लिए कहना) • **Allowed **means to give permission or consent for something to happen. (किसी चीज़ के घटित होने की अनुमति या सहमति देना) 4c:T9a7, The correct answer is: **Fatal**
